li_projects.title: GentlePage
li_projects.description: GentlePage is a browser extension that turns cluttered, hard-to-use webpages into clean, senior-friendly versions. It groups the important actions (like “Pay,” “Book,” “Call,” “Add to Cart”) and presents them in a simple, high-contrast layout with large tap targets and minimal distractions.

posts.text: I'm excited to announce that I will be joining Loop Financial as a Full Stack Developer Co-op role this summer! 💻🚀 I'm looking forward to learning from talented engineers, building real-world solutions, and contributing to Loop’s mission to help businesses seamlessly manage money around the world so they can access more markets, save money, and simplify their operations. A huge thank you to Sarah Sheikh and Ryan Kirshenbaum for their guidance throughout the process!
It was an amazing weekend with an even more AMAZING team. Very thankful for the Western AI team for such a fun experience!
